title: Evidence-package responses name the committed claims they contest (SG-A42)
problem: A response to a GREG evidence package records only coarse grounds, so the record never says which committed assumption, evidence pointer or inference an outside actor disputes. The Seed Genome reviews require that disagreement attack explicit evidence, assumptions, models or values.
baseline: Canonical 9b931994: record_response(grounds=...) with no link from a response to the package's commitments.

alternatives.name: Free-text claim names
alternatives.description: The response lists field names as text.
disadvantages: Not bound to the package's commitments; a response can name a claim that was never made
alternatives.revival_evidence: Recipients cannot compute digests in practice

alternatives.name: Contest moves settlement now
alternatives.description: A targeted contest withholds competence credit from the receipt.
advantages: The contest has an immediate effect
disadvantages: Treats a dispute as a refutation; an outside actor could steer GREG's routing
alternatives.revival_evidence: A founder-signed resolution path for contested claims exists

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Disputes stay unaddressed and SG-A42 stays open.

roles.position: Applies the 2026-11-22 repeat by closing an open residual on the canonical path, as the earlier repeats were applied.
material_concerns: Do not build a parallel cortex
Preserve the lineage without copying text already preserved

roles.position: Extends greg/cognition/disclosure.py and reuses the disclosure.response record; no new ledger type, route or authority path.
Six new mutants; one survived at first (cross-package untargeted disputes) and the test was strengthened.
Read-only surfaces; rollback leaves old responses readable.
A recipient learns what it disputed without seeing withheld values; uncontested is never presented as true.
material_concerns: A contest must never be read as a refutation

evidence.claim: Targets bind to committed claims; decoys, foreign holders and tampered holders are refused
evidence.finding: passes on a real body run

counterevidence.claim: No real institution has responded to a package
counterevidence.finding: the workflow is tested, not used

pass_1.intended_outcome: Every recorded dispute either names the committed claims it attacks or is labelled untargeted, and the founder sees per claim what stands.

advantages.statement: A disagreement gets an address in GREG's own record
advantages.amplified_value: Later corrections can target only the receipts resting on a contested assumption

disadvantages.redesigned_response: Correct by design: only the holder knows what a digest commits to

disadvantages.statement: Uncontested could be read as validated
disadvantages.redesigned_response: Every output states that uncontested is not true and contested is not refuted

comparisons.reversible_experiment: additive fields; revert restores the old behavior

rejected_alternatives.name: Free-text claim names
rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Not bound to the package's commitments

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked the bindings and the read surfaces as deployed.

new_weaknesses.statement: A recorder could attach responses to a package they do not hold
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: The holder must match the package digest and its own digest; mutants cover both

new_weaknesses.statement: Responses for one package could leak into another's map
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Filtered by package digest; the strengthened test catches the cross-package mutant

pass_2.final_design: Digest-bound targets on record_response, a read-only challenge map per package, a cross-package contested-receipts count in Goal Gravity and a read-only CLI view.

residual_risks.risk: No founder-signed console command records a response yet
residual_risks.mitigation: Listed as the next action; the API is unchanged for callers without targets

migration_plan: Additive: responses without targets read as before. Merging is the founder's separate decision.
kill_criteria: A contest changes a receipt, route or competence
A decoy or foreign digest is accepted as a claim
review_trigger: Founder review of the draft PR
